create_Timer_benchmark: create a benchmark Timer with a code statement, globals dict, label, and environment for measuring PyTorch operation performance
test_Timer_blocked_autorange: test the Timer.blocked_autorange method to run repeated benchmark iterations and return timing results
build_Compare_results: build a Compare object from pickled Timer results to compare benchmark measurements across branches and configurations
run_Compare_print: run Compare.print() to display formatted benchmark comparison output with labels and descriptions
create_FauxTorch_overhead: create a FauxTorch wrapper to emulate a slower PyTorch branch with extra nanoseconds per element for benchmark comparison
